### Fluor to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 9, 2026


IRVING, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Fluor Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fluor.com&esheet=54637079&newsitemid=20261109866835&lan=en-US&anchor=Fluor+Corporation&index=1&md5=ae2dd2bfbde0e13926f7700feb692b20) (NYSE: FLR) announced today that management will be hosting one on one meetings at the following conferences for the fourth quarter of 2026:


- **November 12: Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference -** John Regan, Chief Financial Officer and Jason Landkamer, Vice President, Investor Relations.
- **December 2: UBS Global Industrials & Transportation Conference -** John Regan, Chief Financial Officer and Jason Landkamer, Vice President, Investor Relations.
- **December 10: Truist’s 2026 Virtual Nuclear Summit -** Pierre Bechelany, Group President – Energy Solutions and Jason Landkamer, Vice President, Investor Relations.


**About Fluor Corporation**


[Fluor Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fluor.com%2F&esheet=54637079&newsitemid=20261109866835&lan=en-US&anchor=Fluor+Corporation&index=2&md5=53ecc4b3e843267bd5b95b3c0b582646) (NYSE: FLR) is building a better world by applying world-class expertise to solve its clients’ greatest challenges. Fluor’s nearly 23,000 employees provide professional and technical solutions that deliver safe, well-executed, capital-efficient projects to clients around the world. Fluor had revenue of $15.5 billion in 2025 and is ranked 257 among the Fortune 500 companies. With headquarters in Irving, Texas, Fluor has provided engineering, procurement and construction services for more than a century. For more information, please visit[www.fluor.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fluor.com%2F&esheet=54637079&newsitemid=20261109866835&lan=en-US&anchor=www.fluor.com&index=3&md5=bfda5769d70742ad20d511a2ce4793a8) or follow Fluor on[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2FFluorCorp%2F&esheet=54637079&newsitemid=20261109866835&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=4&md5=46e626df103e98b0af7f240201b623e2) ,[Instagram](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Ffluorofficial%2F&esheet=54637079&newsitemid=20261109866835&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram&index=5&md5=50ee715c3492d839214ef924cfa61261) ,[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Ffluor%2Fposts%2F%3FfeedView%3Dall&esheet=54637079&newsitemid=20261109866835&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=6&md5=e1a04d21496a0993132552aeae1632ba) ,[X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2FFluorCorp&esheet=54637079&newsitemid=20261109866835&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=7&md5=adebf784b361c07e23b269cb4b4b0dff) and[YouTube](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fuser%2FFluorCorporation&esheet=54637079&newsitemid=20261109866835&lan=en-US&anchor=YouTube&index=8&md5=bfa4c1f2b37465ecb68c72970551d698) .
